# algolia Provider

The Algolia provider allows you to manage Algolia resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    algolia = {
      source  = "algolia/algolia"
      version = "0.1.2"
    }
  }
}

# Configure the Algolia provider.
# Credentials can also be set via ALGOLIA_APP_ID and ALGOLIA_API_KEY environment variables.
provider "algolia" {
  app_id  = var.algolia_app_id
  api_key = var.algolia_api_key
}

variable "algolia_app_id" {
  description = "Algolia Application ID"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = false
}

variable "algolia_api_key" {
  description = "Algolia Admin API Key"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `analytics_region` (String) Analytics region for Algolia APIs that require regional routing, such as Query Suggestions and Personalization. Can also be set via the ALGOLIA_ANALYTICS_REGION environment variable.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Algolia Admin API Key. Can also be set via the ALGOLIA_API_KEY environment variable.
- `app_id` (String) The Algolia Application ID. Can also be set via the ALGOLIA_APP_ID environment variable.
- `crawler_api_key` (String, Sensitive, Deprecated) Deprecated and unused. No crawler resource or data source exists, so setting this has no effect. Can also be set via the ALGOLIA_CRAWLER_API_KEY environment variable.
- `crawler_user_id` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated and unused. No crawler resource or data source exists, so setting this has no effect. Can also be set via the ALGOLIA_CRAWLER_USER_ID environment variable.
